info.title: Lawgraph API
info.description: Lawgraph is a FastAPI layer over the ArangoDB knowledge graph. It exposes endpoints for articles of law, judgments, parliamentary dossiers and legislative history.

get.description: Looks up an article by `bwb_id` and `article_number`, adds its parent instrument and every judgment that cites it, plus the article references recorded on the article itself.
Upstream dependencies (outgoing references), downstream implications (incoming references) and annex scopes, each with its semantic type, explanation, expert badge and community votes.

get.summary: Passages of judgments that cite an article
get.description: One row per passage: a judgment and the paragraph in it that cites the article, with the lid, onderdeel or aanhef it names, a snippet and the confidence of the detection. Newest judgment first. `court` (ECLI court code), `tier` and `lid` (a lid number the passage names) filter; `total` counts all passages that match. 404 when the article is unknown.

parameters.name: lid

schema.description: A lid number the passage names: '3', '2a'
schema.title: Lid

parameters.description: A lid number the passage names: '3', '2a'

get.description: Every version of one article, identified by the stable BWB `stam_id` so renumbering does not break the chain, oldest first. Each version carries its validity period, text, the kind of change (`change`: introduces / amends / repeals), the amending publication (`amended_by`) and the commencement publication (`commencement`) with their dossiers. 404 when the article is unknown.

Every dossier and document that introduced, changed or proposes to change this article, covering both enacted (`canoniek`) and proposed (`voorgesteld`) changes, and what refers to it. The explanatory documents are at `explained-by`. Returns an empty list when there is no history — never a 404.

The documents that explain this article: every EXPLAINS edge that points at the article, at one of its versions or at its instrument. Newest first, the article-level explanations (`target` `article` and `article_version`) before those of the instrument. An explanation of `scope` `dossier` is written per dossier: the memorandum explains all the changes of the dossier; of `scope` `article` the memorandum names the section about this article in `section_anchor` (the `id` of a section of the document; `GET /api/documents/{key}/passages` gives its text). An `instrument` explanation exists only for a dossier whose law changed no articles, so it is no evidence about this article; filter on `target`. One document appears once per level. `total` counts all explanations, independent of `limit` and `offset`. Returns an empty list for an unknown article — never a 404.
A cheap check whether one or more open bills currently target this article. Returns a flag and the number of open dossiers. Aggressively cached — always 200, never 404.
A paginated list of judgments with filters on court (the ECLI court code), tier (hoge_raad / gerechtshof / rechtbank / bijzonder), date range and a minimum citation count.

parameters.name: from

schema.description: Lower bound on judgment date, YYYY-MM-DD
schema.title: From

parameters.description: Lower bound on judgment date, YYYY-MM-DD

parameters.name: to

schema.description: Upper bound on judgment date, YYYY-MM-DD
schema.title: To

parameters.description: Upper bound on judgment date, YYYY-MM-DD

get.summary: One judgment with the articles it cites
get.description: Looks a judgment up by ECLI, follows its REFERS_TO edges to articles and adds each article with its parent instrument.
A paginated list of statutes, regulations and EU instruments. Supports free-text search (`q`), a jurisdiction filter (`nl`/`eu`), a kind filter and a minimum article count.

The instrument named by its BWB id (`BWBR0001854`), its CELEX number (`32016L0680`) or its node key (`echr_convention`, `verdrag_012345`): identifiers, names, jurisdiction, kind, dates and article count. 404 for an unknown instrument.

get.summary: EU and international links of an instrument
get.description: `implements`: EU acts whose CELEX number the text of this instrument names. `implemented_by`: national regulations that name the CELEX number of this EU act. Both are `IMPLEMENTS` edges between instruments, written from a CELEX number named in the text (`basis`): not a transposition relation, not per article. `international`: treaties (BWB treaties) that articles of this instrument refer to, and ECHR judgments that refer to it or to its articles, each with the evidence of its edge; the graph holds no other links to treaties or to the articles of the ECHR Convention from Dutch text. The instrument is named by BWB id, CELEX number or node key; 404 when unknown. `limit` bounds each list; the `*_total` fields are absolute.

The articles belonging to this instrument (BWB id or CELEX number), in natural article order (9 before 10, '24c' between '24' and '25'). Meant for graph loaders: the text is a short preview, use /api/articles/{bwb_id}/{article_number} for the full content.

parameters.name: text_preview_chars

schema.description: Chars of text to inline as preview
schema.title: Text Preview Chars

parameters.description: Chars of text to inline as preview

get.summary: Every edge incident to this instrument (bulk)
get.description: One round-trip with every edge touching an article of this instrument: REFERS_TO (within and across laws), AMENDS / INTRODUCES / REPEALS and EXPLAINS (legislative history), and so on. PART_OF is excluded by default — it is the structural backbone, not a reference. Beside `edges` the endpoint returns a `nodes` side-payload with the outside endpoints, grouped per collection.

parameters.name: relations

schema.description: Comma-separated whitelist of relations. Default: every relation except PART_OF.
schema.title: Relations

parameters.description: Comma-separated whitelist of relations. Default: every relation except PART_OF.

get.description: Per judgment: light metadata plus the specific articles it refers to. Meant for the case-law layer of the graph. ``total`` is the absolute count, independent of ``limit``.

Dossiers reached through LEGISLATED_IN from (a) the regulation itself and (b) the amending publications (Stb/Trb) that change, introduce or repeal one of its articles. ``via`` says how the dossier is linked (``instrument`` or ``amending_publication``; in the latter case ``publication`` names the newest publication). ``total`` is the absolute count, independent of ``limit``.

The amending instruments (Staatsblad, Tractatenblad, ...) that change, introduce or repeal articles of this regulation (AMENDS / INTRODUCES / REPEALS), newest first. Per publication: the edge count per kind, the number of articles affected, the first effective date and the dossiers. ``total`` is the absolute count, independent of ``limit`` and ``offset``.

get.summary: Instruments referring to this one, or referred to by it
get.description: An aggregation of the REFERS_TO edges between articles of this law and articles of other laws. Each related instrument carries `outbound_count` (references from this law to the other) and `inbound_count` (references from the other law to this one). ``total`` is the absolute count, independent of ``limit``.
Every historical toestand (version) of a BWB law, newest first. Each version carries a validity period (valid_from, valid_until); the current one has ``current=true``.

get.summary: Articles as they stood on a given date
get.description: The articles of a BWB instrument as they applied on ``at_date`` (YYYY-MM-DD), read from the article versions. Empty when no version covers that date.

get.summary: References to articles of other laws
get.description: Article references from this law into articles of other laws, with the semantic type where one has been classified.
The annexes connecting this law to others: its own annexes that other laws refer to, and annexes of other laws that articles of this law refer to.
A map of node id → number of open proposed changes. Only nodes with at least one open change are included. Use it to render the in-flux ring on graph nodes.

get.summary: Bulk activity score per node (heat layer)
get.description: A map of node id → activity count over the past N months, where activity is the number of incoming edges created in that window. Pass months=3 for a 90-day window.

parameters.name: min_count

schema.description: Drop nodes with fewer than this many activity hits. Default 1 returns everything; bump to 2-5 for a much smaller payload without losing visible heat halos.
schema.title: Min Count

parameters.description: Drop nodes with fewer than this many activity hits. Default 1 returns everything; bump to 2-5 for a much smaller payload without losing visible heat halos.

get.summary: Explore a node and its neighbors
get.description: Fetches a node from the given collection and returns its neighbors from the unified edge collection in buckets, one per relation, direction and neighbor collection. Each neighbor carries the edge that leads to it: `edge_id`, `status`, `confidence` and `meta`. A bucket holds one page (`limit` neighbors from `offset`, in the same order on every request), its `total`, and the `next_offset` of the following page (null on the last). `relations`, `node_types`, `direction` and `status` narrow the edges; the totals count what remains.

schema.description: Neighbors per bucket, not per response.

get.description: Every dossier that is not closed yet. ``total`` is the absolute count, independent of ``limit``. Filters on committee slug, subject text and legislative stage.

schema.description: The dossier's latest recognised stage, e.g. 'wetsvoorstel' or 'amendementen'. To filter on a stage being present at all, use ``has_stage``.
schema.title: Stage

get.description: Dossiers with an activity in the given period.

schema.title: Response List Recent Dossiers Api Dossiers Recent Get

get.description: The top documents per dossier for a list of dossier numbers, in one call rather than one per dossier.

One dossier: its title, stage, how many documents, activities, decisions and commitments it holds, and what it links to: the instruments it legislated, amends, introduces or repeals (one item per instrument, relation and status), the committees that lead its activities, its documents per kind and its Eerste Kamer papers.
The documents in this dossier — linked directly or through a case — newest first. ``total`` is the absolute count.
Documents, activities, decisions and commitments in date order, newest first by default. Filter with ``?kind=motie,amendement``.
The nodes and edges by which this dossier proposes to change the law, shaped like the graph endpoint so the frontend can render it directly.
Every parliamentary committee with its number of open dossiers.

schema.title: Response List Committees Api Committees Get

get.description: One query returns every committee with its current members. The alternative is a separate call per committee, 130 times over.

schema.title: Response List Committees With Members Api Committees With Members Get

get.description: One committee with its members and a page of the dossiers it leads, newest first; ``dossier_total`` is the absolute count. By default only current members are returned — a seat with no end date, or an end date still ahead. Pass ``?current_only=false`` for every member the committee ever had. ``limit``, ``offset`` and ``status`` page and filter the dossiers.

parameters.name: current_only

schema.description: Only members currently seated on this committee.
schema.title: Current Only

schema.title: Status

get.description: The activities (debates, hearings) a committee leads, newest first, with the dossiers on their agenda. ``total`` is the absolute count.
Members of parliament, optionally filtered by party or name. By default only people who ever held a seat; pass ``?include_all=true`` to include ministers and other non-members.

schema.title: Response List Members Api Members Get

get.description: One member of parliament or minister.

A member's voting record, newest first. A roll-call names the member directly; any other vote is their faction's, counted only for the period they belonged to it, so historic votes keep the party they were cast under.

The dossiers in which this member signed or submitted documents (``AUTHORED``), newest opened first. Each dossier carries the roles the member had there and the number of documents. ``total`` is the absolute count.

get.summary: The laws this member changes most
get.description: The laws this member proposed changes to through bills, amendments or motions, ranked by how many documents did so.
The parliamentary parties with their member counts, seated ones first. Filter on ``active`` or search names and abbreviations with ``q``.

schema.title: Response List Factions Api Factions Get

get.description: One faction node with its identifiers and raw props. For structured faction metadata use the list endpoint.

The dossiers in which members of this faction signed or submitted documents while they belonged to it, newest opened first. Same shape as the member variant; ``roles`` and ``document_count`` cover all those members.

get.summary: The laws this faction changes most
get.description: The laws this faction proposed changes to through bills, amendments or motions. Same shape as the member variant.
Party abbreviation to hex colour, from the parties' own house styles, for rendering vote chips.

get.summary: Whole graph — every node and edge, no instrument filter
get.description: Every instrument, article, judgment and edge, including nodes that hang off no instrument. `node_types` (`instrument`, `article`, `judgment`; default all three) says which nodes to load and `relations` (`REFERS_TO`, `EXPLAINS`, `PART_OF`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `AMENDS`; default all five) which edges to keep between them.

get.summary: Instrument-level graph — instruments as nodes with aggregated edges
get.description: Every instrument (NL and EU) as a node, with edges between instruments aggregated from article-level references (REFERS_TO, weighted) plus the direct IMPLEMENTS and AMENDS edges. Use this for the layer view, where each node stands for a whole law. `relations` (`REFERS_TO`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `AMENDS`; default all three) says which edges to return.

get.summary: Judgment-level graph — judgments as nodes with citation edges
get.description:
Every loaded judgment as a node, with REFERS_TO edges to the instruments it cites, aggregated from the article-level references (weight = number of distinct articles cited in that instrument).

The instrument nodes are the instruments the judgments cite — useful as anchor points in the visualisation. Use `max_judgments` to bound the size; the default is 1000.
The supported semantic relationship types.

schema.title: Response Get Relationship Types Api Relationships Types Get

get.description: Searches the classified article relationships, optionally filtered by semantic type and/or law (the bwb_id of the source article).
Annexes, optionally filtered to one law (bwb_id) or limited to the annexes used by articles of more than one law (shared_across_laws=true).
One annex with its entries and every article referring to it.
Every article, across all laws, that uses this annex as its scope.

schema.title: Response Get Referenced By Api Annexes  Key  Referenced By Get

get.description: Documents across every source, with metadata only — no text. Backs the document index page. ``total`` is the absolute number of matches, independent of ``limit`` and ``offset``. ``dossier`` keeps the documents of one dossier, linked directly or through a case; an unknown dossier matches nothing.

One document with its text, read from the XML of the paper, its `sections` (the headings of the paper with their offsets into `text`), the dossiers it belongs to and, for an explanatory document, the articles and laws it explains. `text` is null when `normalize tk-content` has not reached it.

get.summary: Passages of a memorandum that explain an article
get.description: The sections of a memorandum (MvT, NvT) that `semantic tk-mvt-articles` linked to the article (or to one of its versions) with `EXPLAINS`, in document order: each with its `text` (a slice of the document text), `confidence` and `match_type`. Empty when the document has no text or no section explains the article; 404 when the document is unknown.

get.summary: Resolve a citation, identifier or law name to one node
get.description: Reads `q` as a citation (`art. 6:162 BW`, `artikel 287 Sr`, `Sr 287`), an identifier (ECLI, BWB id, CELEX id), a Kamerstuk (`36327`, `36327-3`, `Kamerstukken II 2020/21, 36327, nr. 3`) or the name of a law, and answers with the one best match (`id`, `key`, `collection`) and up to five alternatives. `confidence` says how sure the match is. Nothing that fits answers 200 with kind `none` and no match: the query is then words for `/api/search`.

Searches articles, judgments, dossiers and documents. Use `types` to restrict the search to specific collections and `kind` to facet on document or dossier kinds. Every hit has a `score` between 0 and 1, its rank tier for the query: the query is an identifier of the hit (1), its whole name (0.75), the start of its name (0.5), part of its name (0.25) or the hit matched on words only (0.1). Hits of a type come best score first.
Document counts per collection and edge counts per relation type.
A page of decisions — one per Besluit — newest first, optionally filtered by outcome, party, chamber or dossier. ``total`` is the absolute count, independent of ``limit``.

dossier_total.title: Dossier Total
dossier_total.description: Dossiers matching ``status``, independent of limit and offset.

CommitteeDetailDTO.title: CommitteeDetailDTO
CommitteeDetailDTO.description:
A committee with its members and a page of the dossiers it leads.

``dossiers`` is one page; ``dossier_total`` counts every dossier that matches the
``status`` filter, and ``active_dossier_count`` the open ones whatever the filter.

CommitteeWithMembersDTO.title: CommitteeWithMembersDTO
CommitteeWithMembersDTO.description: A committee and its members, without the dossiers payload.

bwb_id.title: Bwb Id
bwb_id.description: The instrument as requested: its BWB id, or its CELEX number for an EU act.

CrossLawDependencyItem.title: CrossLawDependencyItem
CrossLawDependencyItem.description: An article reference crossing a law boundary.

DecisionDTO.title: DecisionDTO
DecisionDTO.description:
One decision with every vote cast on it.

``vote_kind`` says who the votes come from: ``member`` for a roll-call
(``hoofdelijke stemming``), ``faction`` otherwise. ``tally`` is seats per
choice — members per choice on a roll-call — and ``voters`` is how many
cast each choice.

DecisionSummaryDTO.title: DecisionSummaryDTO
DecisionSummaryDTO.description:
One row in the decision browser.

``tally`` sums the seats behind each choice — the number to show for a
result — and ``voters`` counts how many factions (or members) made it.
``external_id`` identifies the motion within a debate; use it rather than
``subject``, which is shared by every motion on the same agenda item.

DocumentPassagesResponse.title: DocumentPassagesResponse
DocumentPassagesResponse.description: The passages of one document that explain one article, in document order.

chamber.title: Chamber
chamber.description: 'TK' or 'EK'; null for a document that belongs to neither chamber, such as a Staatsblad or Staatscourant publication.

is_explanatory.title: Is Explanatory
is_explanatory.description: An explanatory memorandum (memorie of nota van toelichting): a document of this kind explains the articles it introduces or changes.

DocumentSummaryDTO.title: DocumentSummaryDTO
DocumentSummaryDTO.description: One row in the document index.

chamber.title: Chamber
chamber.description: 'TK' or 'EK'; null for a document that belongs to neither chamber, such as a Staatsblad or Staatscourant publication.

is_explanatory.title: Is Explanatory
is_explanatory.description: An explanatory memorandum (memorie of nota van toelichting): a document of this kind explains the articles it introduces or changes.

DocumentTextResponse.title: DocumentTextResponse
DocumentTextResponse.description:
One document with its text.

``text`` is null until ``normalize tk-content`` has run for it: a paper
from before December 1994 has no XML and never gets one. ``sections`` are
the headings of the paper in document order, empty when there is no text or
the structure of the paper could not be read; their offsets are into
``text``. ``dossier_numbers`` are the dossiers the document is PART_OF, in
either chamber; ``explains`` are the articles and instruments it explains,
without duplicates.

DossierCommitteeDTO.title: DossierCommitteeDTO
DossierCommitteeDTO.description: A committee that leads an activity about a dossier.

instruments.title: Instruments
instruments.description: Instruments legislated in, amended, introduced or repealed by the dossier, one item per instrument, relation and status.

committees.title: Committees
committees.description: Committees leading an activity about the dossier.

documents_by_kind.title: Documents By Kind
documents_by_kind.description: Documents per kind (``Motie``, ``Amendement``, ...); a document without a kind is not counted.

DossierDetailResponse.title: DossierDetailResponse
DossierDetailResponse.description: A dossier with the size of everything attached to it, and what it links to.

chamber.title: Chamber
chamber.description: 'TK' or 'EK'; null for a document that belongs to neither chamber, such as a Staatsblad or Staatscourant publication.

is_explanatory.title: Is Explanatory
is_explanatory.description: An explanatory memorandum (memorie of nota van toelichting): a document of this kind explains the articles it introduces or changes.

DossierDocumentDTO.title: DossierDocumentDTO
DossierDocumentDTO.description: One document linked to a dossier.

items.title: Items
items.description: Map keyed by dossier number; each value is that dossier's documents, most recent first.

total.title: Total
total.description: Documents in the dossier, independent of ``limit``.

DossierInstrumentDTO.title: DossierInstrumentDTO
DossierInstrumentDTO.description:
An instrument a dossier is tied to, and how.

``relation`` is ``legislated_in`` (the instrument came out of this dossier) or
``amends``, ``introduces``, ``repeals`` (the dossier changes it, resolved from the
article or instrument that is changed to the parent instrument). ``status`` is
``canoniek`` for what an amending publication enacted and ``voorgesteld`` for what a
bill of the dossier proposes. An instrument with several relations or statuses
appears once per combination.

total.title: Total
total.description: Matching dossiers, independent of limit and offset.

DossierMutationEdge.title: DossierMutationEdge
DossierMutationEdge.description: An edge in the pending-change subgraph.

DossierMutationNode.title: DossierMutationNode
DossierMutationNode.description: A node in the pending-change subgraph.

DossierMutationsResponse.title: DossierMutationsResponse
DossierMutationsResponse.description: The pending-change subgraph of a dossier, shaped like the graph endpoint.

DossierRefDTO.title: DossierRefDTO
DossierRefDTO.description: Reference to a Kamerstukdossier by number; ``title`` is null when unknown.

DossierSenateDTO.title: DossierSenateDTO
DossierSenateDTO.description: The Eerste Kamer papers among a dossier's documents.

DossierSummaryDTO.title: DossierSummaryDTO
DossierSummaryDTO.description:
A dossier in a list.

``track`` is what kind of dossier this is — wetsvoorstel, begroting,
motie — and does not change as it progresses. ``current_stage`` is the
latest stage seen on its documents and activities; ``stages`` lists every
stage with at least one signal, in chronological order.

DossierTimelineResponse.title: DossierTimelineResponse
DossierTimelineResponse.description: Everything that happened in a dossier, in date order.

EdgeStatsDTO.title: EdgeStatsDTO
EdgeStatsDTO.description: Edge counts: total and per relation type.

instrument.description: The other end: the EU act for `implements`, the national regulation for `implemented_by`.

basis.title: Basis
basis.description: What the edge rests on: `celex_named_in_text`, the text of the regulation names the CELEX number of the act. Not a transposition signal.

source.title: Source
source.description: The pipeline that wrote the edge (`bwb-implements-directive`).

EuLinkDTO.title: EuLinkDTO
EuLinkDTO.description:
An `IMPLEMENTS` edge between a national regulation and an EU act.

The edge means that the text of the regulation names the CELEX number of the EU act
(`basis`). It does not say that the regulation transposes the act, nor which articles
do: it links instruments, not articles, and its `confidence` is that of a text match.

id.title: Id
id.description: Arango _id of the article or instrument.

ExplainedTargetDTO.title: ExplainedTargetDTO
ExplainedTargetDTO.description:
What an explanatory document explains: an article, or a law as a whole.

A version of an article resolves to the article itself; a law the document
explains without naming articles is an instrument with ``article_number`` null.

chamber.title: Chamber
chamber.description: 'TK' or 'EK'; null for a document that belongs to neither chamber, such as a Staatsblad or Staatscourant publication.

is_explanatory.title: Is Explanatory
is_explanatory.description: An explanatory memorandum (memorie of nota van toelichting): a document of this kind explains the articles it introduces or changes.

dossier_number.title: Dossier Number
dossier_number.description: The dossier the document is PART_OF (the lowest, if several).

ExplainingDocumentDTO.title: ExplainingDocumentDTO
ExplainingDocumentDTO.description: The explanatory document of an explanation.

FactionDetailDTO.title: FactionDetailDTO
FactionDetailDTO.description: Response for GET /api/factions/{key} — the node as stored.

FactionMembershipDTO.title: FactionMembershipDTO
FactionMembershipDTO.description: One stretch of a member's membership of a faction.

FactionSeatsDTO.title: FactionSeatsDTO
FactionSeatsDTO.description: A party's seats, and where it sits in the hemicycle.

GraphEdgeDTO.title: GraphEdgeDTO
GraphEdgeDTO.description: Graph edge with optional text annotation (for global/article-level graphs).

InstrumentArticleBreadcrumbDTO.title: InstrumentArticleBreadcrumbDTO
InstrumentArticleBreadcrumbDTO.description:
One division an article stands in, outermost first: ``type`` is the element of the
BWB XML (``boek``, ``titeldeel``, ``hoofdstuk``, ``afdeling``, ``paragraaf``, ...),
``label`` as printed ("Hoofdstuk 1"), ``title`` its heading.

InstrumentArticleNodeDTO.title: InstrumentArticleNodeDTO
InstrumentArticleNodeDTO.description:
Lightweight article shape for the graph-loader.

No full ``text`` field — that would balloon the payload when loading
hundreds of articles for a single instrument. ``text_preview`` carries
the first few characters so the FE has something to render on the node;
use /api/articles/{bwb_id}/{article_number} for full content.

InstrumentArticleVersionDTO.title: InstrumentArticleVersionDTO
InstrumentArticleVersionDTO.description: One historical version of a single BWB article.

InstrumentArticlesAtResponse.title: InstrumentArticlesAtResponse
InstrumentArticlesAtResponse.description: Articles of an instrument as-of a specific date.

bwb_id.title: Bwb Id
bwb_id.description: The instrument as requested: its BWB id, or its CELEX number for an EU act.

total.title: Total
total.description: Absolute count of articles matching the request, independent of ``limit`` — use to render a '+N more' badge.

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: Relative to the focal instrument: ``out`` = source is in this instrument, ``in`` = target is in it, ``intra`` = both sides.

meta.title: Meta
meta.description: Optional edge metadata as written by the pipeline.

InstrumentCitationEdge.title: InstrumentCitationEdge
InstrumentCitationEdge.description:
One edge incident to an article of the focal instrument.

Edges keep ``from``/``to`` (not ``source``/``target``) — that matches
the ArangoDB edge shape and the citation graph rendering convention.
For an article-node id reference inside other DTOs, ``id``/``key`` are
used instead.

bwb_id.title: Bwb Id
bwb_id.description: The instrument as requested: its BWB id, or its CELEX number for an EU act.

article_count.title: Article Count
article_count.description: Number of articles in the focal instrument.

total_edges.title: Total Edges
total_edges.description: Number of edges in the response (capped by ``max_edges``).

nodes.title: Nodes
nodes.description: Foreign endpoints grouped by collection name (e.g. ``{'judgments': [...], 'articles': [...]}``).

InstrumentCitationsResponse.title: InstrumentCitationsResponse
InstrumentCitationsResponse.description:
Response for GET /api/instruments/{bwb_id}/citations.

One-shot bundle of every edge incident to the instrument's articles plus
the foreign endpoints those edges point at, grouped by collection.

bwb_id.title: Bwb Id
bwb_id.description: BWB id of a Dutch regulation or treaty; `ECHR-CONVENTION` for the Convention of the ECHR.

celex.title: Celex
celex.description: CELEX number of an EU act.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: BWB type (`wet`, `AMvB`, `verdrag`, ...), treaty kind or publication kind.

source.title: Source
source.description: The source that created the node (`bwb`, `eurlex`, ...).

InstrumentDetailDTO.title: InstrumentDetailDTO
InstrumentDetailDTO.description: One instrument: its identifiers, names, classification and dates.

via.title: Via
via.description: How the dossier is linked: ``instrument`` = LEGISLATED_IN from the regulation itself, ``amending_publication`` = LEGISLATED_IN from a publication that amends, introduces or repeals one of its articles.

publication.title: Publication
publication.description: Identifier (e.g. ``stb-2019-33``) of the newest amending publication linking the dossier; only set when ``via`` is ``amending_publication``.

InstrumentDossierItem.title: InstrumentDossierItem
InstrumentDossierItem.description: One parliamentary dossier touching this instrument.

bwb_id.title: Bwb Id
bwb_id.description: The instrument as requested: its BWB id, or its CELEX number for an EU act.

total.title: Total
total.description: Absolute number of dossiers touching this instrument (independent of ``limit``).

implements.title: Implements
implements.description: EU acts whose CELEX number the text of this instrument names.

implemented_by.title: Implemented By
implemented_by.description: National regulations whose text names the CELEX number of this act.

international.title: International
international.description: Treaties that articles of this instrument refer to and ECHR judgments that refer to it, at most `limit`, treaties first.

cited_articles.title: Cited Articles
cited_articles.description: Articles of the focal instrument that this judgment cites.

InstrumentJudgmentItem.title: InstrumentJudgmentItem
InstrumentJudgmentItem.description: One judgment that cites this instrument.

bwb_id.title: Bwb Id
bwb_id.description: The instrument as requested: its BWB id, or its CELEX number for an EU act.

total.title: Total
total.description: Absolute number of judgments citing this instrument (independent of ``limit``).

InstrumentLayerInstrumentDTO.title: InstrumentLayerInstrumentDTO
InstrumentLayerInstrumentDTO.description: Instrument node in the instrument-layer graph.

outbound_count.title: Outbound Count
outbound_count.description: Number of REFERS_TO edges from articles of the focal instrument to articles of this related instrument.

inbound_count.title: Inbound Count
inbound_count.description: Mirror of ``outbound_count`` in the opposite direction.

InstrumentRelatedItem.title: InstrumentRelatedItem
InstrumentRelatedItem.description: One other instrument linked via cross-article REFERS_TO edges.

bwb_id.title: Bwb Id
bwb_id.description: The instrument as requested: its BWB id, or its CELEX number for an EU act.

total.title: Total
total.description: Absolute number of related instruments (independent of ``limit``).

InstrumentVersionDTO.title: InstrumentVersionDTO
InstrumentVersionDTO.description: One historical version (toestand) of a BWB instrument.

InstrumentVersionsResponse.title: InstrumentVersionsResponse
InstrumentVersionsResponse.description: Paginated list of historical versions for one instrument.

own_article.description: The article of this instrument at the edge, when it has one.

counterpart_article.description: The article of the treaty the reference names.

source.title: Source
source.description: The pipeline that wrote the edge.

InternationalLinkDTO.title: InternationalLinkDTO
InternationalLinkDTO.description:
A `REFERS_TO` edge between this instrument and an international counterpart.

`treaty`: an article of this instrument (`own_article`) refers to a treaty
(`instrument`), and to a treaty article (`counterpart_article`) when the reference names
one. `echr_judgment`: an ECHR judgment (`judgment`) refers to an article of this
instrument (`own_article`) or, without an article, to the instrument as a whole.

leden.title: Leden
leden.description: Numbers of the leden named (`['1', '2']`), ranges written out.

onderdelen.title: Onderdelen
onderdelen.description: Letters or numbers of the onderdelen named (`['a']`, `['2']`).

qualifier.title: Qualifier
qualifier.description: The qualifier as the judgment wrote it, `derde lid`, of the strongest mention. `leden`, `onderdelen` and `aanhef` (this class) are what it names.

paragraph_ids.title: Paragraph Ids
paragraph_ids.description: The paragraphs that cite the article, in reading order.

paragraph_numbers.title: Paragraph Numbers
paragraph_numbers.description: Their printed numbers (`5.3`), those that have one.

snippet.title: Snippet
snippet.description: The text around the strongest mention.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: The confidence of the strongest mention.

mention_count.title: Mention Count
mention_count.description: How often the judgment cites the article. The paragraphs cover the first 100; a judgment that cites an article more often is counted in full.

JudgmentCitedArticle.title: JudgmentCitedArticle
JudgmentCitedArticle.description: An article a judgment cites, with where and how: the strongest of its mentions.

JudgmentDTO.title: JudgmentDTO
JudgmentDTO.description: Rich judgment DTO that hides raw XML but exposes metadata.

cited_articles.title: Cited Articles
cited_articles.description: The same articles, each with the passages of the judgment that cite it: paragraphs, the lid or onderdeel named, a snippet.

JudgmentGraphNodeDTO.title: JudgmentGraphNodeDTO
JudgmentGraphNodeDTO.description: Judgment node in the judgment-layer or global graph.

paragraph_id.title: Paragraph Id
paragraph_id.description: Names the paragraph in the judgment, for a deep link: `rov-5.3` for the numbered consideration 5.3, `kop-5` for a numbered heading, `p-12` (its position) for a paragraph without a number. Unique in the judgment.

number.title: Number
number.description: The number as printed, without its closing dot (`5.3`); not part of `text`. Null for a paragraph without one.

citations.title: Citations
citations.description: Every citation of an article in `text`, one per occurrence, with its span (`text[start:end]`).

JudgmentParagraph.title: JudgmentParagraph
JudgmentParagraph.description: A single paragraph from a judgment, with the article citations in it.

JudgmentSummaryDTO.title: JudgmentSummaryDTO
JudgmentSummaryDTO.description: Lightweight judgment summary for listing matches.

LegislativeHistoryEntry.title: LegislativeHistoryEntry
LegislativeHistoryEntry.description: One entry in the legislative history of an article.

LinkedInstrumentDTO.title: LinkedInstrumentDTO
LinkedInstrumentDTO.description: The instrument at the other end of a link.

MemberDTO.title: MemberDTO
MemberDTO.description:
A member of parliament or a minister.

``active`` means they hold an open faction membership — currently seated.
``party`` comes from that same membership, so the two always agree.

``from_date`` / ``to_date`` are only filled when the member is returned
as part of a committee, where they carry that committee seat's period.

external_id.title: External Id
external_id.description: TK Besluit identifier of the decision.

choice.title: Choice
choice.description: The vote as the source wrote it: Voor, Tegen, Onthouden, …

seats.title: Seats
seats.description: Seats behind this vote; 1 on a roll-call.

MemberVoteDTO.title: MemberVoteDTO
MemberVoteDTO.description:
One vote a member took part in.

``party`` is the party they sat for on ``date``, which may differ from
the party they sit for now.

count.title: Count
count.description: Votes returned; may be fewer than the total.

NeighborBucketDTO.title: NeighborBucketDTO
NeighborBucketDTO.description: The neighbours that share a relation, a direction and a collection: one page of them.

NeighborDTO.title: NeighborDTO
NeighborDTO.description: A neighbour with the edge that leads to it, used by the generic node explorer.

NodeFacetDTO.title: NodeFacetDTO
NodeFacetDTO.description: How many edges of a node share a relation, a direction and a neighbour collection.

NodeNeighborhoodResponse.title: NodeNeighborhoodResponse
NodeNeighborhoodResponse.description: One-shot N-hop neighborhood: focal + reachable nodes + spanning edges.

ParliamentSeatsResponse.title: ParliamentSeatsResponse
ParliamentSeatsResponse.description: The current seat composition of the Tweede Kamer.

section_id.title: Section Id
section_id.description: `id` of the section in `sections` of the document.

match_type.title: Match Type
match_type.description: How the section names the article: `heading_target`, `body_named_law`, `own_number` or `inferred_law`.

PassageDTO.title: PassageDTO
PassageDTO.description: The passage of a memorandum that explains an article.

PublicationDTO.title: PublicationDTO
PublicationDTO.description: An amending publication (Staatsblad, Tractatenblad, ...) as recorded on a version.

RelationshipDTO.title: RelationshipDTO
RelationshipDTO.description: A single semantic relationship row of the search results.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: 1: an identifier (ECLI, BWB id, CELEX); 0.95: a citation read whole; 0.9: a law by exact abbreviation or name; lower for partial names, an article without a law, or several equally good nodes (at most 0.5)

ResolveMatch.title: ResolveMatch
ResolveMatch.description: One node a query may mean, with a target a client can navigate to.

qualifier.title: Qualifier
qualifier.description: The lid or onder of an article citation (`derde lid`)

ResolveResponse.title: ResolveResponse
ResolveResponse.description: The best match for a query and the others that fit; ``kind`` ``none`` when nothing does.

ScopeArticleReference.title: ScopeArticleReference
ScopeArticleReference.description: Annex that scopes the applicability of an article.

SearchResponse.title: SearchResponse
SearchResponse.description: Full-text search response, grouped by type.

score.title: Score
score.description: Rank tier of the hit for the query: 1, 0.75, 0.5, 0.25 or 0.1

SearchResultItem.title: SearchResultItem
SearchResultItem.description: One search hit, typed by collection.

level.title: Level
level.description: 1 for a section without parent, else its parent's + 1.

number.title: Number
number.description: The number as printed in the heading.

article_refs.title: Article Refs
article_refs.description: Every article number the heading names.

SectionDTO.title: SectionDTO
SectionDTO.description: One heading of a paper with the text under it: `text[char_start:char_end]`.

StatsResponse.title: StatsResponse
StatsResponse.description: Database statistics: document counts per collection and edge counts.

agenda_title.title: Agenda Title
agenda_title.description: The agenda item; starts with the date.

TimelineActivityBody.title: TimelineActivityBody
TimelineActivityBody.description: An activity entry: a debate, hearing or other agenda item.

TimelineActivityEntry.title: TimelineActivityEntry
TimelineActivityEntry.description: An activity ABOUT the dossier; ``committee`` is null for a plenary one.

TimelineCommitteeDTO.title: TimelineCommitteeDTO
TimelineCommitteeDTO.description: The committee that leads an activity.

TimelineDecisionBody.title: TimelineDecisionBody
TimelineDecisionBody.description:
A decision entry: the vote, and the document it was taken on.

``tally`` is seats per choice and ``voters`` how many factions (or members)
cast each. ``document`` is the motion or amendment decided on, when it can be
resolved.

chamber.title: Chamber
chamber.description: 'TK' or 'EK'; null for a document that belongs to neither chamber, such as a Staatsblad or Staatscourant publication.

is_explanatory.title: Is Explanatory
is_explanatory.description: An explanatory memorandum (memorie of nota van toelichting): a document of this kind explains the articles it introduces or changes.

TimelineDocumentBody.title: TimelineDocumentBody
TimelineDocumentBody.description:
A document entry: what identifies the document, never its text.

Fetch ``/api/documents/{key}`` for the text. ``url`` is the page of an Eerste
Kamer paper on officielebekendmakingen.nl; ``tk_url`` the paper on tweedekamer.nl.

TimelineDocumentEntry.title: TimelineDocumentEntry
TimelineDocumentEntry.description: A document that is PART_OF the dossier.

chamber.title: Chamber
chamber.description: 'TK' or 'EK'; null for a document that belongs to neither chamber, such as a Staatsblad or Staatscourant publication.

is_explanatory.title: Is Explanatory
is_explanatory.description: An explanatory memorandum (memorie of nota van toelichting): a document of this kind explains the articles it introduces or changes.

dictum_excerpt.title: Dictum Excerpt
dictum_excerpt.description: The first 280 characters of the document's text.

TimelineDocumentSummaryDTO.title: TimelineDocumentSummaryDTO
TimelineDocumentSummaryDTO.description: The document a decision was taken on: what it says and who signed it.

source_role.title: Source Role
source_role.description: The role as the source wrote it.

TimelineSignatoryDTO.title: TimelineSignatoryDTO
TimelineSignatoryDTO.description: Who signed the document a decision was taken on.

count.title: Count
count.description: Distinct documents by this actor that change the law.

TouchedInstrumentDTO.title: TouchedInstrumentDTO
TouchedInstrumentDTO.description: One law an actor proposes changes to, with how often they do.

actor_id.title: Actor Id
actor_id.description: Arango _id of the member or faction.

count.title: Count
count.description: Instruments returned; may be fewer than the total.

TouchedInstrumentsResponse.title: TouchedInstrumentsResponse
TouchedInstrumentsResponse.description: Wrapper for an actor's touched-instruments list.

voter_id.title: Voter Id
voter_id.description: Arango _id of the member or faction.

choice.title: Choice
choice.description: The vote as the source wrote it: Voor, Tegen, Onthouden, …

VoteDTO.title: VoteDTO
VoteDTO.description: One vote cast on a decision, by a faction or — on a roll-call — a member.
